title: Quota handshake and burst reconciliation for non-aligned billing windows
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design and implement a robust 'handshake' protocol and ledger reconciliation for tenant quotas that handles: non-aligned daily/monthly billing windows, tenant timezone differences (including DST), short burst credits in reserved capacity, and transient failover between rate-limiter replicas. Goal is to eliminate double-counting, prevent silent overage, and make resets auditable and idempotent.
problem_statement: Currently tenants with non-standard billing anchors (e.g., mid-month migrations, reseller conversions, or tenants in DST-observing timezones) observe transient quota anomalies: bursts that span the reset boundary can be mis-applied to both pre- and post-reset buckets during failovers or leader handoffs. Reserved capacity leases and pre-allocated burst credits sometimes cause negative available balance after a synchronized reset or during cross-region failover. We need a predictable reset/hand-off behavior and a reconciliation path that can repair historical ledger inconsistencies without customer-visible disruption.
proposed_solutions: 1) Global canonical reset: enforce UTC-aligned resets and convert tenant anchors to nearest UTC window (requires billing changes, high customer impact).

2) Lease-handoff + shadow-ledger: introduce a short-term handshake between rate-limiter leaders where a handoff token and delta shadow entries are written to a reconciliation log before committing a reset. This keeps per-tenant ledger deltas idempotent and replayable.
3) Sliding-credit retention: allow a configurable carry-forward of burst credits for X minutes across resets to avoid double-charging during boundary-cross bursts; tradeoffs for accuracy vs. UX.
4) Post-reset 'repair job': allow asynchronous audit jobs that compare pre/post snapshots and auto-emit correction transactions with a human review queue for high-value tenants.
5) Hybrid: combine (2) handshake + (4) repair job + limited carry-forward window from (3) for best balance of correctness and low customer impact.
chosen_solution: Hybrid: implement a lease-handoff handshake with a small carry-forward grace (default 90 seconds, configurable per-tenant) and an async repair/rollback job for detected anomalies. This minimizes live disruption while enabling deterministic audits and fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Rate-limiter leader handoffs complete without double-counting in >= 99.99% simulated leader failover scenarios
No customer sees an overage event caused by boundary-cross bursts in controlled canary (10 tenants with DST and non-aligned anchors)
Reconciliation job can detect and produce repair transactions for historical inconsistencies within 24 hours for tenants with usage spikes > 2x baseline
Audit logs contain replayable handshake tokens and shadow-ledger deltas for every reset event
Unit and integration tests cover replay idempotency and carry-forward expiry policy
tasks: Design handshake token schema and minimal shadow-ledger row format
Proto: implement leader handoff endpoint + client library in rate-limiter and quota-service
Add carry-forward window config to tenant settings and default to 90 seconds
Implement reconciliation job that ingests shadow-ledger and main ledger and emits repair transactions
Add observability: reset events dashboard, anomaly alerts, and SLI for handoff success rate
Write integration tests simulating DST switches, timezone-misaligned tenants, and multi-region failovers
Rollout plan: internal canary -> opt-in beta customers -> full rollout with feature flag

2026-03-14: Reconciliation job design drafted; requires new S3 staging prefix and small schema migration (DB team)

test_plan: Unit tests for token generation/replay idempotency. Integration harness that replays leader failovers and reset boundaries across simulated tenants in different timezones (including DST transitions). Canary with 10 low-risk tenants for 48 hours measuring handoff success rate and customer-visible quota delta. Reconciliation job run end-to-end in staging against 90 days of synthetic traffic.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy handshake and shadow-ledger feature flag in staging. 2) Small internal canary with platform teams. 3) Opt-in beta for customers with known non-aligned billing. 4) 2-week observation window, then full rollout by feature flag flip. 5) Run reconciliation job for last 7 days post-rollout to catch edge cases.
monitoring_and_alerts: New SLIs: handoff_success_ratio (target 99.99%), carry_forward_hits, repairs_emitted_per_hour. Alerts: handoff_success_ratio < 99.9% for 5m -> P0; repairs_emitted_per_minute > threshold -> pager to billing on-call.
notes_and_tradeoffs: - Increasing carry-forward window reduces customer-visible resets but blurs strict per-window accounting for billing reconciliation; we limit to short default and make it configurable.
